notes: Partition verified: 28 source and 35 target tokens each covered once across 24 units (two לַיּוֹם fusions of three tokens each).
Both occurrences of לַיּוֹם fuse into the single word *daily* under rule 30, headed on the lexeme-bearing noun.
שְׂעִיר עִזִּים is split (*he* / *goat*) because each morpheme has an English word of its own (rule 2); the fusion reading is named in that unit's note.

The supplied *for* of *for a sin offering* is placed on חַטָּאת, whose own appositional function licenses it (rule 33); unlike the italic *for* of 45:5 the ASV does not mark this one as supplied, which corroborates the placement under rule 7.

*the seven days of the feast* takes a supplied *the* on the construct and the written one on the article of הֶחָג (rule 29); the later *the seven days* has one article morpheme, which takes the single written *the* (rules 29, 47).
